{"CommandLine":"python -c "
import requests, json
s = requests.Session()

# Check what routes exist on /api/auth
for path in ['/api/auth/csrf-token', '/api/auth/csrf', '/api/csrf-token', '/csrf-token', '/api/auth/register']:
    r = s.get('http://localhost:5000' + path, timeout=5)
    print(f'GET {path}: {r.status_code}  {r.text[:150]}')

# Also check cookies after login
r = s.post('http://localhost:5000/api/auth/login', json={'email':'a','password':'a'}, timeout=10)
print('Cookies after login:', dict(s.cookies))
print('Response headers:', dict(r.headers))
